subject: Vendor onboarding kickoff: Greenfield Energy — ESG & supplier diversity packets
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@greenfieldenergy.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@greenfieldenergy.com
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Greenfield vendor onboarding / ESG packet (kickoff)

Hi Laura —

Thanks for agreeing to help get Redwood set up as a vendor with Greenfield. We're starting our procurement onboarding this week and I wanted to share our standard supplier questionnaire so we can capture ESG, modern slavery attestation, and diversity information up front.

Attached: GF_Supplier_ESG_Template.xlsx (XLSX) — it contains sections on: sustainability targets, emissions reporting, modern slavery policy, supplier diversity classification, and data residency requirements.

Two asks to kick off:
- Could you confirm the Redwood legal entity name, W-9 details, and preferred PO terms?
- Also please let me know who on your side will own the compliance questionnaire and whether we should expect a completed form or a short attestation.

We'd like to complete onboarding before 3/6 so we can issue the initial PO. Happy to jump on a 30-min call if that's easier.

Thanks,
Samir
Head of Vendor Ops
Greenfield Energy

---

Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Greenfield vendor onboarding / ESG packet (kickoff)

Hi Samir —

Appreciate the packet. We're ready to proceed. Quick answers up front:
- Legal entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- W-9: attached (see redwood-w9.pdf in our shared doc); please confirm whether you need an EIN or address variation for your AP system.
- Preferred PO terms: Net 45 is our default for new customers; we can agree Net 30 if needed for this pilot.

Owner for questionnaire: I've asked Dev (Operations lead) to own the ESG and modern slavery responses; Rachel will handle procurement setup and PO routing. We'll return the completed XLSX with inline answers plus a signed supplier-diversity attestation.

Next steps I propose:
1) Rachel will send our vendor-setup form (inc. tax and billing) and a list of Redwood contacts for contract and invoicing.
2) Dev will review the ESG template and flag any items that need clarification (data residency, subprocessor lists).
3) We aim to return the completed packet and signed attestation by 3/2.

Would a Tuesday 3/3 follow-up call at 10am PT work for you if we need to walk through items?

Thanks — looping Rachel and Dev.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0189

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@greenfieldenergy.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Greenfield vendor onboarding / ESG packet (kickoff)

Hey Samir / Laura —

I've started going through the ESG template. A couple of clarifying points before we populate:
- Data residency: the template asks for where customer data is stored. Can you confirm whether Greenfield requires EU-only residency for any scope, or is US-based storage acceptable? We currently host inference logs in us-west-2 by default but can discuss options for dedicated/private deployments.
- Modern slavery attestation: the form requests a signed company-wide policy and a list of supply-chain audits in last 24 months. We have a published policy and an internal audit summary; would a redacted audit report suffice?
- Supplier diversity classification: can you confirm whether you accept self-attested diversity status, or do you require third-party certification (e.g., WBENC, NMSDC)?

I'll draft initial responses and attach the company's modern slavery policy for your review. If any of these items are binding for contract execution, flag them and we can prioritize.

On the DocuSign front: if you prefer signature routing, send a DocuSign envelope and we'll sign there.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Head of Operations | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.com

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick responses and the clarifying questions. A few notes:
- Data residency: Greenfield's initial contract requires US-region storage only; no EU-only requirement for this engagement.
- Modern slavery: a redacted audit summary is acceptable; we need the signed company policy and a one-paragraph attestation on controls.
- Supplier diversity: self-attestation is acceptable for pilot vendors; certification is only required for >$1M spend vendors.

I've attached the signed supplier-diversity attestation our procurement team uses — see supplier-diversity-form_signed.pdf.

Next: Please send the completed XLSX and the signed attestation back to procurement@greenfieldenergy.com by EOD 3/2. If anything is blocking, we'll hold a 30-min call on 3/3 at 10am PT.

Best,
Samir
Head of Vendor Ops
Greenfield Energy
